meta.title: Ben, Meet Me at Ten
meta.textType: functional: notes and messages about when and where to meet

paragraphs: Tom and Ben want to ride their bicycles on Saturday. It is Friday, and they are in Teacher Nick's class. Teacher Nick writes on the board with his back to them. So Tom writes a note for Ben. The note says, "Ben, meet me at the bus station at ten o'clock. Tom." Tom passes it under the desk to Ben. Ben answers on the back, "OK. I will bring the ball. Shall we go to the park?"

Tom thinks for a minute, and then he writes a change. "Meet at the library, not at the bus station. A quarter past ten." "Wait at the entrance, and do not be late." Ben writes, "I will be early. Could I borrow your water bottle?" Tom writes, "Yes, you can. Shall I bring some fruit?" Ben writes, "Yes, please. Thanks!" Tom writes, "You're welcome. See you on Saturday."

On Saturday morning, Tom sees a note on the fridge. It is from Mom, and a magnet holds it. The note says, "The wifi is down, so I can't send you a message. Please come home by half past twelve." Tom reads it and smiles, and he says, "I can pack my bag by myself." He puts on his helmet and goes out.

Ben waits at the entrance of the library. He is early, and Tom is not late. "Shall we ride to the park first?" asks Ben. "Yes, and we will go home by half past twelve," says Tom. "I will see you later," says Ben, and he laughs. Tom laughs too, because they are together. They ride away.
text.summary: Tom and Ben plan a bike ride with notes. Tom changes the place, Mom leaves a note on the fridge, and the boys meet at the library.
